about.title: About Us
about.description: BMGT Enterprise sources and supplies industrial materials to shipbuilding, oil & gas, construction and general engineering through a single point of contact. Based in Dubai, U.A.E.
about.heroTitle: Your global partner in industrial materials
about.heroSub: Built for unforgiving sectors, run by people who have worked in them.
about.whoTitle: One point of contact, one chain
about.whoP1: Shipbuilding, ship repair, oil and gas, and construction are unforgiving sectors, and {{name}} was built for them. We source and supply industrial materials through a single point of contact, pairing modern sourcing with people who have worked these industries first-hand.
about.whoP2: Our catalogue is broad and priced to keep project budgets intact — and we would rather keep a client for a decade than win one purchase order. That is not a slogan about service; it is the reason we will tell you when a part is three weeks out instead of letting you find out at the gate.
about.whoP3: The company works out of Dubai and supplies worldwide, which puts us close to the yards, sites and rigs across the Gulf while keeping the sourcing reach that a project of any size needs.
about.howTitle: Three questions, asked of every order
about.howIntro: Every enquiry that comes through the door gets measured the same way, whether it is a single bearing or a tonnage of plate.
about.p1Body: A quote that takes a week is a quote that has already cost you time. We answer with what we can supply, what the lead time is and where the risk sits — and if we cannot help, we say so on the same day rather than sitting on the enquiry.
about.p2Title: Does it hold up on site?
about.p2Body: Material that fails at the point of use costs far more than the saving that bought it. We quote what will do the job in service, and where a cheaper option exists we put both in front of you with the difference explained rather than quietly substituting.
about.p3Body: We buy through established manufacturers and distributors, and we keep the chain traceable. Nothing about a low price is worth material of unknown origin arriving on a project that will be inspected.
about.ctaTitle: Work with a supplier who answers.
about.ctaSub: Tell us about the project and we will tell you plainly what we can supply and when.

mechanical.detail: Most mechanical enquiries reach us mid-breakdown, so we treat them that way: identify from a part number, a photograph or a worn sample, then quote what is available now against what is available correctly. We will tell you which is which.

ppe.detail: We can hold repeat items against a call-off so replacement gear is not a fresh procurement exercise every quarter. Sizing runs and consumable rates are worth agreeing up front.

shipbuilding.name: Shipbuilding, Ship Repair & Yacht Refits
shipbuilding.blurb: Materials that keep yards moving and vessels seaworthy.
shipbuilding.lead: From hull plate to switchgear, we supply yards and repair docks worldwide. Less a vendor, more the crew handling your material chain.
shipbuilding.detail: Newbuild, repair and refit each pull on a different part of that chain. A newbuild programme wants steady, scheduled supply against a bill of materials; a vessel in dock wants an answer this afternoon. We are set up for both, and we would rather tell you a part is three weeks out than let you find out at the quayside.
points: Newbuild supply scheduled against the build programme
Repair and dry-dock enquiries handled at short notice

1.body: A vessel in dock costs money by the hour. Repair enquiries are answered the same day where we can, and flagged honestly where we cannot — you hear a three-week lead time now, not at the quayside.

2.title: Documented as it ships
2.body: Class and survey paperwork travels with the material rather than behind it, so nothing arrives that your surveyor then has to chase.

Material that arrives early is material you have to store and guard; material that arrives late stops a trade. We phase deliveries against your programme and keep one contact across the whole job, from groundwork through to handover.

Single point of contact across every trade package
